Container.Name: PlexLanguageConfigurator
Container.Overview: Set the audio and subtitle language for a whole series or movie at once, for any Plex Home user. Shows how many episodes have each language before applying.

Config.Name: Plex URL
Config.Description: Address of your Plex server as seen from this container, e.g. http://UNRAID-IP:32400

Config.Name: Plex admin token
Config.Description: The Plex server owner's X-Plex-Token. Needed to act on behalf of Home users.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Library index, Bazarr mappings and job history. Keeps the cache across restarts and updates.

Config.Name: Focus language
Config.Description: Language code for the Missing page and the Plex label (ita = Italian).

Config.Name: Plex label
Config.Description: Label added to every show/movie that has the focus language.

Config.Name: Auto label
Config.Description: true = add the label automatically after each library refresh. false = only when you press the button.

Config.Name: Label criteria
Config.Description: any, audio or subtitles: which streams count as having the language.

Config.Name: Label minimum coverage %
Config.Description: Only label series where at least this % of episodes have the language. 0 = any episode.

Config.Name: Remove stale labels
Config.Description: true = also remove the label from titles that no longer have the language.

Config.Name: Refresh minutes
Config.Description: How often to check Plex for new or changed items (only changes are re-read).

Config.Name: Full rescan hours
Config.Description: How often to re-read everything, to catch changes Plex doesn't flag.

Config.Name: Plex concurrency
Config.Description: Parallel requests to Plex while indexing.

Config.Name: Bazarr API key
Config.Description: Optional. Bazarr Settings, General, API key.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID that owns the appdata files.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID that owns the appdata files.
